# DevCodeHub

> Realtime code snippet exchange for development teams. Create a snippet, share
> its link, and everyone with the link edits the same buffer live. Free, with no
> account required.

DevCodeHub was designed and built by Shams Ali Shaikh, a full stack developer
working in Next.js, React and Firebase. It is his own project, maintained solo.

## Key facts

- Name: DevCodeHub
- URL: https://devcodehub.cloud
- Developer: Shams Ali Shaikh (https://github.com/dev-shamsali)
- Price: free, no paid tier
- Account required: no, sign-in is anonymous and automatic
- Realtime backend: Firebase Realtime Database
- Editor: CodeMirror 6 with JavaScript and TypeScript highlighting
- Media sharing: images and zip archives, delivered through ImageKit, 25 MB per file
- Snippet retention: unpinned snippets clear after 36 hours, pinned snippets persist

## Pages

- https://devcodehub.cloud/ : what DevCodeHub is, how it works, FAQ, developer bio
- https://devcodehub.cloud/editor : the realtime collaborative code editor
- https://devcodehub.cloud/media : share images and zip archives with a team, many files per share
